I answered Ottilie in the #canyon-random thread to confirm the correction: the 2027 renewal at Sablehithe Paper Mill is now 68 seats, because the customer changed it on the call.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. The seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in a team channel is fine. Her correction will also be saved in gbrain automatically, since every channel message is recorded there as it happens.
